method: Manual estimates from supplied original portrait/enlarged unchanged crop; not exact geometric reconstruction.

left_image_visible_pupil_center.occlusion: Upper pupil joins upper-lid ink; visible black pupil estimate.

right_image_visible_pupil_center.occlusion: Upper pupil joins upper-lid ink; visible black pupil estimate.

left_image_visible_iris_center_prior_est.occlusion: Center of visible gray region, NOT unoccluded nominal iris-disc center; prior .890 ratio used this.

right_image_visible_iris_center_prior_es.occlusion: Center of visible gray region, NOT unoccluded nominal iris-disc center; prior .890 ratio used this.

mouth_seam_center.occlusion: Visible painted seam midpoint, not bottom lip shadow.

chin_outline_tip.occlusion: Visible external chin line; hair does not obscure tip.

cautions: Do not equate model nominal iris UV center (upper-lid occluded) with visible gray-region centroid.
Prefer visible pupil shader-center to manually estimated visible pupil; allow2px uncertainty and separate sensitivity registration.
No conclusion that chin is too long/short from raw unregistered pictures.
Roll estimate differs slightly if pupil versus gray-region centers are used; both are approximate.
